label: Feasibility, Adherence, Acceptance and Usability of a Multimodal Telemonitoring for Pediatric Post-COVID Syndrome: A Bicentric Pilot Study.
summary: Existing healthcare infrastructure struggles to meet the complex care required for pediatric Post-COVID Syndrome (pPCS). Telemonitoring offers potential to enhance care access, reduce patient burden, and ensure continuity. This study introduces and evaluates a novel, multimodal telemonitoring concept for pPCS with high translational potential for broader pediatric chronic and post-infectious conditions.
